title: Pong U
name: PongU-1.4.zip
author: SpookScoop93
details:
A simple, lightweigh (~500 kb size with metadata) pong clone written in C with SDL2. (Cross-platform. For more platforms check out my github.)

Features:
Very small size. (As I said, 524 kb with metadata)

Controls:
| DPad |
Up - Go up
Down - Go down
Left - Go down
Right - Go up

Warning:
Does not support WiiMotes. (Tho the controls are made with those in mind in case I add the support)
requirements: Aroma for the bundled WUHB. Keep the complete package; any separate RPX variant needs the environment documented by the project. The source explicitly excludes Wii Remote support.
setup: Extract the complete SD bundle to the SD root; keep every app folder, music file and companion asset. Launch the matching executable from its documented environment.
